lines.text: What's at a black hole's edge? Look closer.
lines.phonemes: wˌʌts æɾə blˈæk hˈoʊlz ˈɛdʒ? lˈʊk klˈoʊsɚ.

lines.text: The edge is called the event horizon. Escape speed is the speed needed to leave for good. Past that edge, escaping would take more than light speed.
lines.phonemes: ðɪ ˈɛdʒ ɪz kˈɔːld ðɪ ᵻvˈɛnt hɚɹˈaɪzən. ɛskˈeɪp spˈiːd ɪz ðə spˈiːd nˈiːdᵻd tə lˈiːv fɔːɹ ɡˈʊd. pˈæst ðæt ˈɛdʒ, ɛskˈeɪpɪŋ wʊd tˈeɪk mˈɔːɹ ðɐn lˈaɪt spˈiːd.

lines.text: Nothing travels faster than light, so nothing gets out from there. Now picture a friend, hovering close to it, while you watch from far away.
lines.phonemes: nˈʌθɪŋ tɹˈævəlz fˈæstɚ ðɐn lˈaɪt, sˌoʊ nˈʌθɪŋ ɡˈɛts ˈaʊt fɹʌm ðˈɛɹ. nˈaʊ pˈɪktʃɚɹ ɐ fɹˈɛnd, hˈʌvɚɹɪŋ klˈoʊs tʊ ɪt, wˌaɪl juː wˈɑːtʃ fɹʌm fˈɑːɹ ɐwˈeɪ.

lines.text: Gravity really does slow clocks. GPS satellites must correct for relativity to keep good time. The closer to a black hole, the slower a clock ticks. Now compare the two views.
lines.phonemes: ɡɹˈævᵻɾi ɹˈiəli dˈʌz slˈoʊ klˈɑːks. dʒˌiːpˌiːˈɛs sˈæɾəlˌaɪts mˈʌst kɚɹˈɛkt fɔːɹ ɹˌɛlətˈɪvᵻɾi tə kˈiːp ɡˈʊd tˈaɪm. ðə klˈoʊsɚ tʊ ɐ blˈæk hˈoʊl, ðə slˈoʊɚɹ ɐ klˈɑːk tˈɪks. nˈaʊ kəmpˈɛɹ ðə tˈuː vjˈuːz.

lines.text: To you, far away, your friend's clock seems to tick slower. To someone hovering close, everyone else seems to speed up. The closer they hover, the bigger the gap.
lines.phonemes: tə juː, fˈɑːɹ ɐwˈeɪ, jʊɹ fɹˈɛndz klˈɑːk sˈiːmz tə tˈɪk slˈoʊɚ. tə sˈʌmwʌn hˈʌvɚɹɪŋ klˈoʊs, ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn ˈɛls sˈiːmz tə spˈiːd ˈʌp. ðə klˈoʊsɚ ðeɪ hˈʌvɚ, ðə bˈɪɡɚ ðə ɡˈæp.

lines.text: Both views are true. Time depends on where you are, and how strong gravity is.
lines.phonemes: bˈoʊθ vjˈuːz ɑːɹ tɹˈuː. tˈaɪm dᵻpˈɛndz ˌɔn wˈɛɹ juː ɑːɹ, ænd hˌaʊ stɹˈɔŋ ɡɹˈævᵻɾi ɪz.

lines.text: Light time: we photographed a black hole in twenty nineteen. Its light had traveled about fifty-five million years.
lines.phonemes: lˈaɪt tˈaɪm: wiː fˈoʊɾəɡɹˌæft ɐ blˈæk hˈoʊl ɪn twˈɛnti nˈaɪntiːn. ɪts lˈaɪt hæd tɹˈævəld ɐbˌaʊt fˈɪftifˈaɪv mˈɪliən jˈɪɹz.

lines.text: Next: a planet lighter than water.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ plˈænɪt lˈaɪɾɚ ðɐn wˈɔːɾɚ.
